item.title: James Krivchenia - Performing Belief
item.description: When the winter is wintering , I find my listening habits going two ways. On some days I lean into the wintery-ness, listening to moody, atmospheric, sparse sounds - appreciating the slowing down that comes with the frosty season. But when the (pleasant) slowing down turns into (dreadful) fatigue and lethargy, that’s when I need a record that goes in the exact opposite direction, a record that’s energetic and upbeat and that makes me want to get up and move around and get things done.
